name: Shader test whitespace normalization

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Normalize whitespace inside the single `transformed_quad_uses_analytic_coverage` test before checking the `unrounded && axis_aligned` guard. This removes indentation sensitivity while preserving the same shader semantic assertion and changing no production or WGSL code.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Use experiment 21's two deterministic checkpoint failures as the before evidence. Change only the test body in `crates/gpux/crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_renderer.rs`. Run the focused test, then the full diagnostics suite sequentially with visible names twice, followed by package formatting, check, and warning-denied Clippy. Accept only if the focused test and both 52/52 sequential suites pass and production/WGSL hashes remain unchanged.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: The focused test changes from deterministic failure to pass, both sequential full suites pass 52/52 in about one second, and only test code changes. This restores a reliable broad gate for subsequent gpux telemetry and optimization experiments.

rayx: Two sequential gpui_wgpu diagnostics suites passed 52/52 in 0.85 s and 0.81 s.
Package formatting, diagnostics check, and warning-denied Clippy passed.
